```
           studio                      EXPERIENCE    one surface, where product work happens
              │
            crew                       CONTROL       intent → governed, verified work
              │                                      (wicked-core engine = internal detail)
           garden                      CAPABILITY    the catalog: skills + tools agents use
              │
   estate + interactive                FOUNDATION    system of record: graph · memory ·
                                                     knowledge · evidence · events — and the
                                                     document engine crew spawns & proxies
```

The architecture is **4 roles and 4 contracts** — not 4 repos, not 4 binaries. Every
wicked-* asset is assignable to exactly one plane; every cross-plane interaction goes
through the plane's contract, never around it.

| Plane | Role | Owns | Assets |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Experience** | The front door. Studio = the coder-facing surface, a pure HTTP/WS client of crew's API. | Rendering, editing surfaces, deliverable editors. Nothing semantic. | wicked-studio (own repo since 2026-08, task #98; crew bundles its dist as the default local skin) |
| **Control** | Intent in, verified work out. Orchestration, governance, gates, identity/trust enforcement. | Project/run/gate state, workflows-as-data, evaluator≠creator, the public API. | wicked-crew (+ wicked-core engine, internal) |
| **Capability** | The catalog — what agents can *do*. The only sanctioned way agents touch the foundation. | Skills, tools, playbooks, councils. | wicked-garden |
| **Foundation** | System of record — what the system *knows*. One runtime profile (`local\|team`). | Code graph, memory, knowledge, evidence (vault/ledger), events (bus), documents. | wicked-estate (+ bus, vault, ledger as internal packages) · wicked-interactive (the document engine — crew spawns & proxies it; no standalone UI) |","class":"chunk","label":"## The model

wicked-core is how crew executes (control runtime) — neither leaks into the other's box, and the published version-deps pattern keeps them decoupled with zero repo-layout constraints. — rationale source: plane-boundaries.md@d4924f167b1f7b120b076c26bac6e492e8ddbdbb#PAT-1305","class":"chunk","label":"PAT-1305 (error pattern rule): estate is what the system kno","node_id":"kchunk synthetic rule-rationale/PAT-1305:","score":0.020833333333333332,"source":"plane-boundaries.md@d4924f167b1f7b120b076c26bac6e492e8ddbdbb#PAT-1305"},{"body_snippet":"PAT-1303 (error pattern rule): Control means intent in, governed verified work out: evaluator≠creator (a creator structurally cannot self-grade), deny-dominates dual gates, and "done" re-derived from evidence — never asserted. — rationale source: plane-boundaries.md@d4924f167b1f7b120b076c26bac6e492e8ddbdbb#PAT-1303","class":"chunk","label":"PAT-1303 (error pattern rule): Control means intent in, gove","node_id":"kchunk synthetic rule-rationale/PAT-1303:","score":0.02054794520547945,"source":"plane-boundaries.md@d4924f167b1f7b120b076c26bac6e492e8ddbdbb#PAT-1303"},{"body_snippet":"PAT-1304 (error pattern rule): Enforcement is two-tier by design: hooks are fail-open advisory, crew/core gates are fail-closed — never introduce a third enforcement tier (TARGET-ARCHITECTURE contract 3). — rationale source: plane-boundaries.md@d4924f167b1f7b120b076c26bac6e492e8ddbdbb#PAT-1304","class":"chunk","label":"PAT-1304 (error pattern rule): Enforcement is two-tier by de","node_id":"kchunk synthetic rule-rationale/PAT-1304:","score":0.02027027027027027,"source":"plane-boundaries.md@d4924f167b1f7b120b076c26bac6e492e8ddbdbb#PAT-1304"},{"body_snippet":"## 7. Installer skill — pointer model, instruct-only

Served as a **`skill://` MCP resource rendered at runtime** from the §6 data file. The
hand-rolled resource router serves `&'static str` today; rendering widens
`McpResource.content` to `Cow<'static, str>` — a local type change, no framework involved
(there is no rmcp router anywhere in the workspace).

**Pointer model — no curated install-command registry.** Install commands rot (npm↔brew,
version pins, OS differences). Estate ships, per server: the probe mapping (exact binary
name) and **one pinned official docs/package pointer**. The consuming agent fetches current
instructions from the pointer, executes them **under its own permission gate**, then
**re-probes the exact binary name** (npm's `pyright` package provides `pyright-langserver` —
verify the binary, not "install succeeded"). Offline degrades to the package name.

**Boundary, stated verbatim: wicked-installer remains the sole scripted-install surface;
this skill instructs, never executes; language servers stay out of registry.json.**

### Garden #347 re-scope

Estate owns probe / serve / route (capability report, installer skill resource, edit-plane
tools). wicked-garden #347 is re-scoped to the CC-plugin wiring that **consumes** estate's
surface — skill discovery/registration on the garden side, zero duplication of the probe or
pointer data. (Note only — no garden repo edits from this lane.)","class":"chunk","label":"## 7. Installer skill — pointer model, instruct-only
